scripts.bake: npm run bake:terrain && npm run bake:map
scripts.bake:terrain: remotion still TerrainBake-Wide public/terrain/terrain-wide.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 --timeout=600000 && remotion still TerrainBake-Close public/terrain/terrain-close.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 --timeout=600000
scripts.render:1080: for c in SatelliteTargeting-V1 SatelliteTargeting-V2 WorldTracking-V1 WorldTracking-V2; do remotion render $c out/$c-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5 || exit 1; done
scripts.render:4k: for c in SatelliteTargeting-V1 SatelliteTargeting-V2 WorldTracking-V1 WorldTracking-V2; do remotion render $c out/$c-4K.mp4 || exit 1; done
